title: Simply good, I purchased after 1 month of use.
body: I started using this app 1 month before for free. The Free version also has widget that's the most fantastic thing about it.(please don't ever change it), which is very thoughtful. the tracker is easy to use. There are a lot of things that can be improved and that is why I purchased this app and sent some feature request to the developer. Hoping i ll have it soon.
author: ItsHotFix
